game: Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas - The Definitive Edition

findings.name: Gang Tags (graffiti)
findings.detail: 100, all in Los Santos. Required for 100%. Reward: weapons at Grove Street (Tec-9, AK-47, sawn-off, Molotovs per PowerPyx).
findings.trackable: Not confirmed which Stats screen shows a tag count.

findings.name: Snapshots
findings.detail: 50, San Fierro. Required for 100%. Only the floating icon needs photographing. Reward: weapons plus $100,000 (PowerPyx).

findings.name: Horseshoes
findings.detail: 50, Las Venturas. Required for 100%. Reward: weapons plus $100,000. One source says they max Luck, which is unverified.

findings.name: Oysters
findings.detail: 50, underwater across the map. Required for 100%. Reward: $100,000, lung capacity, sex appeal. Sources disagree on the perk wording.

findings.name: Unique Stunt Jumps
findings.detail: 70 total, $500 each. NOT required for 100% per PowerPyx and Sportskeeda. One weaker source (gtaintel) says required.

findings.name: Story and asset missions
findings.detail: 98 story missions. 26 asset missions: Courier 3, Trucking 8, Quarry 7, Zero RC 3 ($30,000), Wang Cars 4 ($50,000), Valet level 5 (must wear Valet outfit).

findings.name: Vehicle challenges
findings.detail: BMX: 19 checkpoints (cycling skill over 20%). NRG-500: 18 checkpoints. Chiliad Challenge: 3 routes, daytime 07:00-18:00, cycling over 40%.

findings.name: Vehicle missions
findings.detail: Firefighter, Paramedic, Vigilante: level 12 in one go. Pimping: level 10 in one go. Freight: level 2. Taxi: 50 fares total (not one go).

findings.name: Races and stadium events
findings.detail: Race tournaments: 1st in all 19 (LS 9, SF 6, LV 4; the PowerPyx page also says 16 once, inconsistent). Checkpoint races: 6 at LV airport. Stadium: 8-Track 1st (20% driving skill), Blood Bowl, Dirt Track 1st (Mon/Wed only), Kickstart 26+ points (not Mon/Wed).

findings.name: Vehicle schools
findings.detail: Bronze minimum counts: Driving 12, Boat 5, Bike 6, Flying 10 (33 lessons). Silver/gold not required, only unlock vehicles. Trophy-style achievement 'School's Out' = fully complete one school.

findings.name: Misc 100% items
findings.detail: Export/Import: 3 lists of 10 cars (up to $1,444,000). Shooting range: 4 challenges in one session. Properties: 24 plus 5 hotel suites = 29, $879,000. Gyms: all 3 moves from each of 3 trainers (needs 35%+ muscle).

findings.name: Not required for 100%
findings.detail: 70 unique jumps, girlfriends at 100%, taking all gang turfs, silver/gold school medals. Also not mentioned as required: burglary, casino, Chiliad beyond routes, Bigfoot.

findings.name: 100% completion rewards
findings.detail: $1,000,000, ammo refill, double vehicle strength (per PowerPyx), Hydra on Sweet's roof, Rhino under Grove Street bridge, plus 'Remastered' achievement/trophy (100 pts in GTABase list).

findings.name: Existing DE achievement list (side-content related)
findings.detail: Remastered; ...Here we go again (new game after 100%); A Legitimate Business (3 export lists); School's Out; What the City Needs / Savior / Rescue a Kitten Too? (12 levels); Yes I Speak English (50 taxi fares); Bike or Biker (BMX or NRG); Not a Player (date every potential girlfriend); Ain't Nothing But a G Thing (own all turfs + properties + $1,000,000); Sticky Fingers ($10,000 burglary); Lucky Spinner; What are the Odds (Inside Track); Double or Nothin'; Today Was a Good Day; 81 Years Too Late (24h on foot hunting Bigfoot); Freight Date; Get a Pump; Beat the Cock; Metrosexual ($6,969); Represent; High As a Kite; Lots of Guns; Swiss Army Strife; Chick Magnet; Smooth Moves; The American Dream; I'll Have Two Number 9s; With Extra Dip. Useful for avoiding duplicates. No collectible-count achievement was listed.

trackableStats.where: Pause menu > Stats (Stats screen). Reader comment says it shows overall % but not gym moves or Chiliad times.

versionNotes.note: Switch has no native trophy system; the lists above are Xbox/PlayStation/Social Club style. Cheats disable achievements/trophies on PS/Xbox/PC. Whether the Switch version has any in-game achievement tracking was NOT confirmed.
Switch version has gyro aiming and touch controls; heavier performance/visual downgrade than PS4. Reader comment mentions a Switch-specific gym-training bug (unverified).
Latest Switch patch found is 1.0.7 (Perfectly Nintendo); notes cover stability and mission fixes only.
